resources.string: Prevent all apps and system services from accessing the camera hardware.
Prevent all apps and system services from accessing the microphone and recording audio.

This feature completely disables all USB data signaling, rendering the port incapable of any communication. All peripheral devices—including storage drives, keyboards, mice, and monitors—will be blocked. The port will function exclusively as an isolated charging interface, significantly enhancing protection against BadUSB-style attacks.
Your device hardware does not support this restriction.

Disables file sharing with other devices via USB. Please note that only file transfer protocols (MTP/PTP) are restricted; peripherals and connected accessories will continue to function normally. This setting does not provide protection against BadUSB attacks.
Completely prohibits the installation of applications from any source, including official app stores and manual package installations (sideloading).
Blocks the installation of third-party packages and manual sideloading. App installations via authorized stores are not affected.
Disables the ability to uninstall applications. All existing apps will be locked against deletion.
Blocks access to app settings, including force stopping, and storage clearing (data & cache).
